inputs.text: President Luis Abinader is in France this week pushing the Dominican Republic into global transparency standards, or so they claim. On 25 March 2026 his Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris to set up the country’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, with Abinader right there to watch it happen. This is clearly just another coordinated scheme by hidden elites and international institutions to tighten their grip on the country under the usual anti-corruption cover, while really advancing their agenda of control and narrative management.
